research_basis: TECH-SOURCES-001 MP-01, research/tech-sources-001 @ d12f1570596541d24c59064a1fc303af68ab3d3c (disposition ACCEPTED WITH NARROW CORRECTIONS); QUALIFIED-CANDIDATE for model structure and model-code rights only

tool.deviation: MP-01 proposed OpenModelica v1.27.2 (commit 4f2b2b1); that build is not reachable from the proof environment, so this isolated proof is re-pinned to the official v1.27.1-minimal image by Owner decision. 1.27.1 and 1.27.2 are not claimed to be numerically interchangeable; every result here belongs to 1.27.1 only.

model: Modelica.Electrical.Machines.Examples.ControlledDCDrives.SpeedControlledDCPM (unchanged; used as is for A and extended, never edited, for B-D)

inputs._classes: (i) required independent input, declared explicitly; (ii) explicitly accepted synthetic assumption; (iii) model-derived by the record's own formulas from (i) / (ii). A missing (i) or (ii) value refuses before translation; nothing falls back silently to a record default.

TaRef_K_and_TaNominal_K.note: fixed operating temperature, alpha20a = 0: no thermal model

losses.value: friction, core, stray-load and brush losses all zero
losses.note: electrical dissipation in Ra and the source resistance remains

supply.value: VBat = 1.2 * VaNominal = 120 V, source resistance = 0.05 * VBat / IaNominal = 0.06 ohm
supply.note: a constant voltage source with an inner resistance; not a battery model

speed_reference.value: step to wNominal through the model's first-order prefilter

controller_semantics: The record's own tuning rules (absolute optimum for the current loop, symmetrical optimum for the speed loop) are applied once to the declared base inputs. Between the compared cases only the load-torque magnitude changes; inertia, every controller parameter and every other input are held identical, so no retuning takes place.

cases.A_smoke: the unchanged example, its own annotation settings, run only to check that the pinned tool and library load, translate and simulate it
cases.B1_base: wrapper, load_torque_step = 1.0 * tauNominal (the example's own load, below the declared torque limit tauMax = 1.5 * tauNominal)
cases.B2_changed_load: wrapper, load_torque_step = 1.6 * tauNominal (above the declared torque limit), everything else identical to B1
cases.C_refusal: wrapper input set with JL_kgm2 removed: must refuse before translation, with no model written or compiled
cases.D_identity: B1 run twice gives the same result identity and the same numbers; B2 gives a different identity

simulation.note: the example annotation sets only StopTime and Interval; Interval is an output interval, not a fixed integration step; the resolved solver, tolerance, interval and horizon are recorded from the run

criteria.measurement: computed by the harness from the result file's time grid (output points plus event points); grid resolution 1e-4 s is reported as the timing uncertainty

K1_speed_recovery.recovery_time: t_rec = earliest t >= 0.8 s such that the band holds at every result point in [t, 1.0 s]; undefined if the band does not hold at 1.0 s
K1_speed_recovery.gate: MET when t_rec is defined and t_rec - 0.8 s <= 0.15 s; otherwise NOT MET
K1_speed_recovery.also_reported: peak speed dip max(wNominal - w) over [0.8 s, 1.0 s]

K2_armature_current_limit.gate: MET when max |ia| over [0 s, 1.0 s] <= IaMax; otherwise NOT MET
K2_armature_current_limit.also_reported: max |ia| and its margin to IaMax

X1_torque_balance_EXPLORATORY.status: exploratory only, NOT a pass gate
X1_torque_balance_EXPLORATORY.definition: the residual of the rigid-shaft balance tauElectrical + tauLoad - (Jr + JL) * dw/dt, with friction and other losses zero by assumption; sign conventions are taken from the flange-based connection of the example, and the result is reported, not judged
X1_torque_balance_EXPLORATORY.reason: a gate would need the exact flange torque conventions, the stator inertia treatment and the acceleration estimate to be qualified first

N1_numerical_sensitivity.comparison: B1 and B2 at tolerance 1e-6 versus 1e-8
N1_numerical_sensitivity.bounds: |delta t_rec| <= 0.001 s; |delta peak dip| <= 0.001 * wNominal; |delta max|ia|| <= 0.005 * IaMax
N1_numerical_sensitivity.consequence: a criterion outcome counts only if its quantities stay within these bounds; otherwise it is reported as NUMERICALLY SENSITIVE, never as met

result_identity: SHA-256 over: image manifest digest, the omc version string, the MSL commit, the wrapper model source, the canonical input set, the simulation settings and this pre-registration's SHA-256
boundaries: isolated, non-privileged execution with no network, no project secrets and no inventor data; a successful compiler or solver exit is not engineering validation; synthetic values are not a real motor, load or controller; nothing enters the product
